lignes.zh: 她挎着一个竹篮去买菜。
lignes.pinyin: tā kuà zhe yī ge zhú lán qù mǎi cài
lignes.fr: Elle part faire les courses, un panier de bambou au bras.
lignes.en: She goes grocery shopping with a bamboo basket on her arm.

lignes.zh: 市场上，农民拉来了两筐苹果。
lignes.pinyin: shì chǎng shang nóng mín lā lai le liǎng kuāng píng guǒ
lignes.fr: Au marché, un paysan a apporté deux paniers de pommes.
lignes.en: At the market, a farmer has brought two baskets of apples.

lignes.pinyin: yī kuāng píng guǒ duō shao qián
lignes.en: "How much for a basket of apples?"
